en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 13. Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari narrated to me from Abī Sa’īd (Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn Zakariyyā Al-‘Adwi Al-Basri), from Nasr ibn ‘Ali, from ‘Ali ibn Ja’far, who said: His brother, Mūsā ibn Ja’far (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)), said:

The Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) held the hands of Ḥasan and Ḥusain (a.s.) and said, “Those who love these two boys and love their father and mother will be with me in my position on the Day of Judgment.”
